archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) mixed with Archetype 2 (Performance Pro)
rationale: As a youth table tennis club ('UKS Sokolik Niemodlin'), the design needs to balance energetic, approachable vibes (Youth Coaching) with structured, high-contrast clarity for league results and ranking tables. We avoid corporate templates by using Neo-brutalist crisp edges, high-contrast Navy, and energetic Orange.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-[#1F3A7A]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1F3A7A]

surface_strategies.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1F3A7A]/10 shadow-sm
surface_strategies.cards_news: bg-white border-2 border-[#1F3A7A]/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300
surface_strategies.cards_data: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-sm
surface_strategies.buttons_primary: bg-[#F08019] text-white font-bold tracking-wide rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#D96C12] transition-colors shadow-sm
surface_strategies.buttons_secondary: bg-[#1F3A7A] text-white font-bold tracking-wide rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#162B5C] transition-colors shadow-sm
surface_strategies.table_header: bg-[#F8FAFC] border-y-2 border-[#1F3A7A] text-[#1F3A7A] font-bold py-3 px-4
surface_strategies.table_row: border-b border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors py-3 px-4

components.tables: Use Shadcn Table component but override with `table_header` and `table_row` styles. Ensure dense padding for League and Tournament pages.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for switching between League Rosters and Match Results. Use solid #1F3A7A for active tab state.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form primitives for the Admin panel (login, create post, add match result). Inputs should have a 2px border on focus matching #F08019.
components.badges: Use rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold. Orange for 'Win', Navy for 'Loss', Slate for 'Upcoming'.

pages_instructions.Home_News: Tetris bento grid for news items. Highlight the latest post as a massive hero card (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8). Include Facebook link buttons on cards with `data-testid='fb-link-btn'`.
pages_instructions.League: Control room dense layout. Two main sections: Team Roster (cards with player photos/names) and Match Results (clean tabular view with prominent W/L badges).
pages_instructions.Amateur_Tournament: Focus on the ranking table. Highlight top 3 players with Gold/Silver/Bronze or Orange accents. Sortable columns (Points, Matches Played).
pages_instructions.Admin_Panel: Utilitarian dashboard. Sidebar navigation. Clear, high-contrast tables for entity management. Orange primary buttons for 'Add New' actions.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on #F08019 or #1F3A7A backgrounds is white.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid`. Examples: `data-testid='news-card'`, `data-testid='league-tab'`, `data-testid='admin-login-btn'`, `data-testid='add-match-form'`.

images.description: Two ping pong paddles and an orange ball on a blue table. Use as a faded background or hero banner image.
Blue paddle and white ball. Use as fallback image for news articles or tournaments.
Overhead shot of paddle and ball. Good for 'About the Club' section or side-image.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: `Outfit` for headings and `Chivo` for body. Set up in tailwind.config.js.
Implement the Navigation Header first with the club logo placeholder/text and links to: Aktualności, Liga, Turniej Amatorów, Panel Administratora.
For the League and Tournament pages, use Shadcn UI Table but apply the high-contrast `table_header` styles defined above.
Implement the Admin Panel under a `/admin` route with a simple layout containing a sidebar for managing News, Matches, Players, and Tournaments.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or generic gray. Stick to the Navy (#1F3A7A) and Orange (#F08019) palette.
Ensure all buttons, form inputs, and links have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
